rules.statement: An appeal to the Supreme Court is not a re-hearing and should be decided according to the law existing at the date of the commencement of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now I take leave to think that the Supeme Court of Ceylon in its appellate jurisdiction under section 40 of the Courts Ordinance 'in hearing a case in appeal ' deals only with appeals ' strictly so-called,' and does not deal with them by way of re-hearing, but according to the law existing at the time when the action was begun."
